scale.4: Accurate and complete for requested scope; valid citations; no unsupported material claims.

blinding: Read only blind instructions and six question/answer files plus repository source. No sibling artifacts, keys, benchmark reports/cases, histories, runtime registries or credentials inspected. Answer prose may partially reveal provenance; conditions and metrics remained hidden.
method: Static source reads only; no repository changes, application/tests execution, services or delegation. Repeated-question answers independently checked against shared source.
limitations: No conclusions about index freshness, live service outcomes, latency or token savings. Grading reflects requested major stages, not exhaustive documentation of every configuration.

notes.detail: Ordinary-query metadata boosts/surface penalties depend on include_metadata. Defaults activate it through test filters or meta_boost, but an explicitly unfiltered metadata-disabled configuration sorts ordinary queries by RRF alone. The answers correctly describe the major/default path; this condition could be explicit.
